entry.name: jit.la.inverse
entry.digest: Calculate the inverse of a matrix
entry.description: jit.la.inverse calculates the inverse with respect to multiplication of a given input matrix. The input matrices must be 1-plane or 2-plane matrices of the type float32 or float64. If a 2-plane matrix is used, it is assumed that the data is from the set of complex numbers.
